title: Product card template
description: Declarative card structure for ONE product, style-agnostic. Lives at products/<product_id>/template.json. Cards are declared by semantic role; each renderer maps role → its own visual layout. This file drives /detect (frontend override form) AND the generic builder.

brand.description: 页脚品牌名（如 YF Life 万通保险 / AIA 友邦保险）。缺省用渲染器默认值。

company.description: 保险公司代号（对应 CardCompany.code，如 YF / AIA）

cover.description: Default cover asset + per-style defaults. Per-proposal user uploads override 'image'.

image.description: Path (relative to SKILL_ROOT) of the default cover/hero image, if any.

overridable.description: Which cover fields the user may override via the frontend, e.g. ['image'].

copy.description: Optional per-product brand copy. Any string keys; referenced by cards via {copy.key} placeholders or bound directly by the builder. Free-form on purpose, but the canonical set is: label, plan_short, variant, english_name, audience, audience_long, hook, tagline, cover_eyebrow, plan_default, cover_subtitle_suffix, capital_label.

cards.description: Order matters; the Nth entry becomes card idx N. Each card is a role + style-agnostic content/binds.

role.description: Semantic role in a controlled vocabulary: hero|cover|summary|numbers|coverage|multi|chart|irr|reasons|letter|essay|company|features|risks|table|list|note|scenario|death|ci-list|image|fulltext

overridable.description: Which slots the frontend lets the user override (e.g. ['subtitle', 'body']).

styles.description: Which render styles include this card (llm/classic/guizang). Omit = all styles.

bound_data.description: Optional extra static content the builder splices into this card verbatim (e.g. {'items': [...], 'stats': [...], 'examples': [...]}). Values may contain {placeholders}.

generated.description: Data the builder computes from normalized tables for this card.

llm.description: If present, this card's body is generated by an LLM slot.

omit_when.description: Products for which this card is skipped (e.g. multi-card omitted for pwl).

variants.description: Optional per-sub-variant bound_data overrides, keyed by variant id (parser.json variant.rules[].key). Deep-merged over base bound_data when the detected variant matches, e.g. {'standard': {...}, 'advanced': {...}}
